in_sanskrit.name: Sekh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Power
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sekh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sekh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sukh' which means happiness and contentment. In Hinduism, Sekh is considered as the God of Power and Strength. He is often associated with the Sun and Fire.
